title: Term lock: one name per concept across abstract, demo and code
outcome: A glossary that fixes one public name per concept so the abstract, diagram, demo and contracts never use two words for one thing
acceptance: Covers at least: envelope, read/write set, gateway, recorder, witness, verify, lineage hold, graded containment (suspend/revoke/release), taint-scoped revert, re-run vs replan, root candidates, oracle S*, R and C, TTI-detect/attribute, TTC
Each entry: locked term, one-line plain-English gloss a banking reader understands, banned synonyms, and matching code/contract identifier where one exists
Maya confirms every code identifier matches contracts C1-C6 (or flags the mismatch)
